captions.tiktok: On the Day of Judgment, 3 things will speak for you. Number 3 most of us forget. Sahih Muslim 804, Musnad Ahmad, Abu Dawud 1400.
captions.shorts: 3 things will speak for you on the Day of Judgment - straight from the Sunnah.
captions.reels: 3 things will speak for you when you cannot speak for yourself. Number 3 most forget.

segments.text: One day you will stand before Allah, unable to speak for yourself. But three things will speak for you.
Number one. The Qur'an. Every verse you ever recited is coming back, to defend the one who kept it close.
Recite the Qur'an. On the Day of Resurrection, it will come as an intercessor for those who recite it.
segments.arabicText: اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ فَإِنَّهُ يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ شَفِيعًا لِأَصْحَابِهِ
segments.foot: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him - Sahih Muslim 804

segments.text: Number two. Your fasting. Every day of hunger you carried, only for Allah, was quietly building a voice.
Fasting will say: my Lord, I kept him from food and desire by day. So let me intercede for him.
segments.arabicText: يَقُولُ الصِّيَامُ أَيْ رَبِّ مَنَعْتُهُ الطَّعَامَ وَالشَّهَوَاتِ بِالنَّهَارِ فَشَفِّعْنِي فِيهِ
segments.foot: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him - Musnad Ahmad (sahih)

segments.text: Number three, the one most people forget. One chapter, Surah al-Mulk. Recite it, and it defends you until you are forgiven.
A chapter of thirty verses, that interceded for a man, until he was forgiven.
segments.foot: Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him - Abu Dawud 1400 (hasan); Qur'an 67:1

segments.text: So fill your days with His words, and your nights holding back for Him. Build the voices now, that will speak for you then.
